wiki.title: Leo Delperdang
wiki.extract: Leo Delperdang (born February 18, 1962) is an American politician. He has served as a Republican member for the 94th district in the Kansas House of Representatives since 2017. He and his wife have two sons. He has an engineering degree and a Masters of Business Administration degree. He has been active in the Kansas Patriot Guard and his local west-side Wichita neighborhood association. He was endorsed by Kansans for Life, the National Rifle Association, the Wichita Chamber of Commerce and the Wichita Builders Association.
